title: Extension of scalars along a field extension is an exact functor
statement: Let $K\subset L$ be a field extension and let $-\otimes_KL:\operatorname{Mod}_K\to\operatorname{Mod}_L$, $V\mapsto V\otimes_KL$, be the extension-of-scalars functor from $K$-vector spaces to $L$-vector spaces [def-weil-vector-space-scalar-extension]. Then $-\otimes_KL$ is additive and exact: it preserves finite limits (because $L$ is a free, hence flat, $K$-module, every vector space having a basis) and finite colimits (because it is left adjoint to restriction of scalars). In particular it carries short exact sequences of $K$-vector spaces to short exact sequences of $L$-vector spaces.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: apply it to `f = algebraMap K L`, flat by `RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff` (Mathlib/RingTheory/RingHom/Flat.lean:31) and the instances `Module.Free.of_divisionRing`, `Module.Flat.of_free`; finite colimits are preserved because `extendScalars f` is left adjoint to `restrictScalars f` (`ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj`, Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/ChangeOfRings.lean:885, with `Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits`), and it is additive by `Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Additive.lean:42) from the instance `(restrictScalars f).Additive` (ChangeOfRings.lean:327)
